{{Quote|I'm here commanding a hard target mission to exterminate k'lor'slug's in this tomb. They're&hellip;horiffic things. Mouths bigger than your head.|Sergeant Cormun explaining his mission to a Sith acolyte|<ref name="TOR:KI" />}}
A '''mission''' to exterminate [[K'lor'slug/Legends|k'lor'slugs]] in the [[Tomb of Ajunta Pall|tomb]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ajunta Pall]] was assigned to [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Cormun (Imperial Army)|Cormun]] of the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army's]] [[Korriban regiment]] around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]]. As part of the mission for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Cormun used elements of the [[Fifth Infantry company]], and attempted to destroy the k'lor'slug's egg chambers using explosives. His plan was unsuccessful and resulted in the loss of three squads of [[Imperial soldier]]s.<ref name="TOR:KI" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
However, Sergeant Cormun was able to convince a [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] to help him detonate the explosives, which resulted in the destruction of the egg chambers.<ref name="TOR:KI" />
